about_the_game:
GnollHack transforms one of the greatest and deepest games of all time into a fully modern experience — built for today’s players. Animated graphics, immersive sound, music, and voiceovers, and a refined interface bring the legendary NetHack formula to life like never before.

This isn’t just a port. This is NetHack evolved.

100% free. No ads. No microtransactions. Ever.

 

A Legend, Reborn

For decades, NetHack has defined depth and complexity in gaming. GnollHack takes that legendary foundation and elevates it with modern design, accessibility, and immersion — without sacrificing what made it great.

Endless Adventure, Limitless Possibilities

Every run is unique. Procedurally generated dungeons, unpredictable encounters, and countless items ensure that no two adventures are ever the same. Win with strategy, creativity, and clever thinking — not with reflexes.

Designed for Modern Players

Clear visuals. Rich audio. Whether you're on a quick session or a deep dive, GnollHack fits perfectly into how you play today.

Depth that No Other Game Matches

Complex systems. Meaningful choices. Real consequences. GnollHack offers a level of depth and emergent gameplay that few modern games even attempt.

 

New to Roguelikes?

Start your journey with a non-permadeath mode, adjustable difficulty, and a learning curve designed to welcome you in — not push you away.

Love Modern Roguelites?

If you enjoy randomness, loot, and replayability, GnollHack delivers — but with deeper systems and smarter gameplay than most roguelites.

Hardcore Roguelike Fans

Permadeath. Deep mechanics. True challenge. This is the real deal — uncompromising and endlessly rewarding.

NetHack Veterans

Experience NetHack like never before. Expanded systems, new content, deeper progression, and a fully modern presentation — all while staying true to its roots.

 

  • The definitive modern NetHack experience

  • Deep, turn-based gameplay where every decision matters

  • Animated graphics, sound effects, music, and voiceovers

  • Fully optimized for desktop play

  • Procedurally generated dungeons with infinite replayability

  • Expanded mechanics, items, monsters, and progression systems

  • Multiple modes and difficulty levels for all players

  • Completely free — no ads, no paywalls, no compromises


Enter the dungeon. Outsmart everything. Become a legend.

Download GnollHack now — and experience NetHack the way it was meant to be played today!

 

Enabling Dedicated GPU

In the case your computer has multiple GPUs, GnollHack uses the integrated GPU by default. If you want to use the dedicated GPU, you must enable it as follows:

1. Open Windows Settings.

2. Go to System → Display → Graphics.

3. Add a desktop app and select "C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\GnollHack\GnollHackM.exe".

4. GnollHackM should appear in the app list. Click on it to expand its options. Select High Performance as GPU preference.

Troubleshooting

If the game is stuck in the loading screen in the "Done loading" phase, you can fix the problem as follows:

1. Open Control Panel.

2. Click Clock and Region.

3. Click Region.

4. Select the Administrative tab and, in the Language for non-Unicode programs section, click Change system locale.

5. Select English (United States) as the current system locale and click OK.

Alternatively, you can download an MSIX installer for the game from GnollHack's GitHub releases page. Installing the game through it will also fix the problem.
